Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and was turning left when the vehicle was
struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through on the same roadway. Driver 1 stated that the impact was
forceful and that they felt an immediate jolt to the neck and upper back, later reporting whiplash symptoms. The
nature of the collision and the force involved appear consistent with the reported injury. Damage to the front driver
side of Driver 1's vehicle and the rear of Driver 2's vehicle matches the impact described by both parties.
Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general position of both vehicles and the damage observed. No
independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the statements of the drivers and the photographs. A
Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle; responding officers and the wintesses who were interviewed
confirmed that Passenger was seated inside at the time of the collision. Some minor scratches on the lower bumper
area appear to be older than this incident and were noted separately. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the
insurance policy covering the vehicle.
